name: Zyre Elementor Addons
author: VertexMediaLLC

sections.description:
Zyre Elementor Addons is a lightweight and user-friendly Elementor addon that helps you build modern WordPress websites faster—without writing any code.

The plugin includes a powerful Theme Builder with Header/Footer Builder, allowing you to design complete website layouts directly inside Elementor with full control and live preview.

It also features a built-in Mega Menu Builder and provides 60+ free widgets, including the Off-Canvas Menu and Advanced Search Box with filters. Every widget comes with multiple pre-designed styles, so you can quickly achieve professional designs without extra effort.

In addition, Zyre Elementor Addons includes pre-built templates and template blocks, enabling you to design stunning pages faster without starting from scratch.

Complete Demo & Walkthrough

Useful Links

Widgets Demo | Documentation | Videos

Key Features

  • Free Theme Builder (Header, Footer, Single, Archive)
  • Free Mega Menu Builder, Off-Canvas Menu, and Advanced Search Box with Filters—rarely available in other free plugins.
  • 60+ free Elementor widgets
  • Pre-built widget styles
  • Widget & pre-style control panel
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • No coding required
  • One-click template import
  • Compatible with Elementor & Elementor Pro
  • Support RTL

60+ Free Elementor Widgets

Below is the complete list of widgets included in the free version.

  • Heading: Headings with subtitle, suffix, and description.
  • Advanced Heading: Gradient-style headings with prefix and suffix.
  • Gradient Heading: Gradient text headings and subheadings.
  • Dual Color Heading: Headings with dual-color text styles.
  • Image Heading: Image-filled text headings with advanced styling.
  • Button: Customizable buttons with onClick actions.
  • Dual Button: Two-button layouts with connectors and onClick functionality.
  • Info Box: Icon or image boxes with title, description, lists, and CTA.
  • Icon Box: Feature boxes with icons, text, and call-to-action buttons.
  • Flip Box: Front and back content with smooth flip animations.
  • Call to Action: CTA blocks with icons, ribbons, and connectors.
  • Featured Banner: Promotional banners with rich content options.
  • Feature List: Icon or image-based feature lists.
  • Numeric List: Numbered or icon-based content lists.
  • Image List: Lists using images or icons with links.
  • List Group: Flexible list layouts with icons or images.
  • Image Carousel: Responsive image sliders with captions.
  • Team Member: Team profiles with social links and optional modal.
  • Testimonial: Customer reviews with ratings and logos.
  • Post Grid: Display posts with custom queries and pagination.
  • Logo Grid: Grid layout for brand or client logos.
  • Image Grid: Display images with filters & grid layout.
  • Logo Carousel: Animated logo sliders.
  • Social Icons: Social profile icons with styling options.
  • Social Share: Social media sharing buttons.
  • Advanced Accordion: Collapsible accordion content sections.
  • Advanced Toggle: Toggle layouts with template support.
  • Fun Fact: Animated counters with icons or images.
  • Alert: Dismissible alert notifications.
  • Skill Bars: Animated progress indicators.
  • Countdown: Event and promotion countdown timers.
  • Business Hour: Office or business hours display.
  • Drop Cap: Stylized first-letter typography.
  • Animated Text: Animated headlines and text effects.
  • News Ticker: Scrolling news-style content.
  • Divider: Decorative dividers with icons or text.
  • Toggle: Content switcher for comparisons or pricing.
  • Subscription Form: Mailchimp email subscription forms.
  • Contact Form 7: Style Contact Form 7 forms visually.
  • Site Title: Dynamic site title widget.
  • Site Tagline: Display site tagline with styling.
  • Site Logo: Show logo or custom image.
  • Navigation Menu: Advanced responsive menu builder.
  • Mega Menu: Design mega menus with full Elementor control.
  • Off-Canvas: Responsive off-canvas panels with smooth toggles.
  • Search Box: Advanced Search box with category filters.
  • Post Title: Display post titles dynamically.
  • Page Title: Display page titles dynamically.
  • Post Excerpt: Excerpt with read-more option.
  • Post Content: Full post or page content display.
  • Post Thumbnail: Featured image display options.
  • Post Meta: Author, date, categories, and more.
  • Post Navigation: Previous and next post links.
  • Post Comments: Styled comment sections.
  • Archive Title: Archive page title display.
  • Archive Description: Archive description output.
  • Archive Posts: Archive post listings.
  • Author Box: Author bio and details.
  • PDF View: Embed PDF files with download option.
  • Lottie Animation: Lightweight Lottie animations.
  • Advance Tab: Create horizontal & vertical tabs to display HTML text, and saved templates.
  • More coming…

Theme Builder

Zyre Elementor Addons includes a free Theme Builder that allows you to visually create:

  • Headers
  • Footers
  • Single Posts & Pages
  • Archive Pages

All layouts are built directly inside Elementor with live preview support.

Performance & Usability

  • Enable or disable widgets as needed
  • Disable unused pre-styles for faster loading
  • Clean and intuitive UI
  • Works with all Elementor-compatible themes
  • Optimized for speed and stability

Pro Version

ZyreAddons Pro is currently under development and will include advanced widgets, extended Theme Builder features, and premium templates.

Privacy Policy

Zyre Addons uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

This plugin may also display an optional newsletter subscription form in the WordPress dashboard. If a user voluntarily submits their email address, it is sent to Mailchimp for newsletter subscription purposes. No email data is collected or transmitted without user action.

Privacy Policy: https://zyreaddons.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://zyreaddons.com/terms-of-use/

Third Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • Lottie (https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web)
  • PDFObject (https://github.com/pipwerks/PDFObject)
  • Micromodal (https://github.com/ghosh/Micromodal)
  • Isotope (https://isotope.metafizzy.co)
  • Typed.js (https://github.com/mattboldt/typed.js)
  • jQuery.vTicker (https://github.com/richhollis/vticker)
  • jQuery Numerator (https://github.com/garethdn/jquery-numerator)
  • jQuery countdown (https://github.com/sonnyt/downCount)

Unminified source files are included inside the plugin directory.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party services in the following cases:

1. Social Sharing Services

The plugin includes a social share feature that allows users to share content on third-party platforms such as Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and others depending on configuration.

No data is sent automatically. Data is transmitted only after explicit user interaction.

When a share button is clicked, the following data may be sent directly from the user’s browser to the selected service:
– Current page URL
– Page title
– Optional image, description, hashtags, or other share parameters (if configured)

The plugin does not store or process this data on its own servers.

2. Mailchimp API

If the site administrator enables the newsletter subscription feature, and a user voluntarily submits their email via the subscription form widget, the submitted email and any additional provided fields are sent to Mailchimp for newsletter subscription only.

Endpoint: https://*.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/
Terms of Use: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://mailchimp.com/legal/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Zyre Elementor Addons or Click Upload Plugin and upload the plugin file.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Start using widgets inside Elementor.

For a more detailed explanation, watch the following video.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Is it compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes. Fully compatible.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. Works with all Elementor-compatible WordPress themes.

Is it safe to update?

Yes. Updates are designed to be safe. We recommend backups as a best practice.

Does it work with other Elementor Addons?

Yes! Zyre Addons is fully compatible with other Elementor Addons and also adds extra features to enhance your overall experience.

Does it slow down my website?

No. Zyre Elementor Addons is lightweight and allows you to disable unused widgets and features for better performance.
